name: showreel-09-liquid-glass
caption:
Is this glass real? 💧

It's code: liquid glass rendered in WebGL. The glass is the transition: each next app appears inside it, then floods out across the screen. Music at night, a wallet, weather at noon, a map under a lens. Real refraction, light that changes with every scene.
Save it for your next interface, or send it to the designer who loves glass.
